nodes.name: Enregistrer en SQL

parameters.query:
WITH data AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(ordre int, content text, contexte text, resume text, questions jsonb, metadata jsonb, embedding text, mots_cles jsonb, entites jsonb, relations jsonb)
),
chunk_ins AS (
  INSERT INTO rag_chunks (document_id, ordre, content, contexte, resume, questions, metadata)
  SELECT $2::bigint, d.ordre, d.content, d.contexte, d.resume, ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(d.questions)), d.metadata FROM data d
  RETURNING id, ordre
),
emb AS (
  INSERT INTO rag_embeddings (chunk_id, embedding)
  SELECT c.id, d.embedding::vector FROM chunk_ins c JOIN data d ON d.ordre = c.ordre
  RETURNING chunk_id
),
mots AS (
  INSERT INTO rag_mots_cles (chunk_id, mot)
  SELECT c.id, m FROM chunk_ins c JOIN data d ON d.ordre = c.ordre, jsonb_array_elements_text(d.mots_cles) AS m
  RETURNING 1
),
ents AS (
  INSERT INTO rag_entites (chunk_id, nom, type)
  SELECT c.id, e->>'nom', e->>'type' FROM chunk_ins c JOIN data d ON d.ordre = c.ordre, jsonb_array_elements(d.entites) AS e
  RETURNING 1
),
rels AS (
  INSERT INTO rag_relations (chunk_id, sujet, relation, objet)
  SELECT c.id, r->>'sujet', r->>'relation', r->>'objet' FROM chunk_ins c JOIN data d ON d.ordre = c.ordre, jsonb_array_elements(d.relations) AS r
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM chunk_ins) AS chunks, (SELECT count(*) FROM emb) AS vecteurs, (SELECT count(*) FROM mots) AS mots_cles, (SELECT count(*) FROM ents) AS entites, (SELECT count(*) FROM rels) AS relations

nodes.notes: Credential à choisir : Postgres (Supabase, Session pooler)

meta.description: Sous-workflow universel : remplace un document dans Supabase (documents, chunks, embeddings, mots-clés, entités, relations) par lots de 10 avec pause.
